pages.text: Cooked chicken coated in Blaze extract. $(bold)Never frosts.$()

pages.title: Field Notes
pages.text: Restores serious hunger but doesn't replace other food.$(br2)After Phase 5, a $(l:advanced/nether_substitutes)Sulfur Igniter$(/l) replaces the blaze powder.$(br2)$(flavor)Nutritional Services rates it "technically edible."$()
One cooked chicken, one pinch of blaze powder or an igniter.$(br2)$(flavor)Tastes like regret and capsaicin.$()
